name: Explain phase route
objective: Prepare, in this repo, everything the workflow needs to run explaining as a phase: (1) knowledge check — a CLI command and server endpoint that validates a chapter against the publish rules without publishing; (2) a ready-to-apply package for the bootstrap: the create-phase explain route, the DECOMP reference (research, book outline, an outline gate the operator signs), the per-chapter slice procedure (draft, validate, critic, one revision), an explain-critic agent, and the REVIEW reference (whole-book read, render in the reader, publish every chapter at once, private) plus the acceptance gate; (3) an updated handoff-explain.md. The bootstrap repo itself is out of scope; the operator relays the package.

review.note: round 1: explain-review privacy probe proves nothing in production (401 for any visibility); PATCHES §3 L36→L37; Doc impact missing backend.md. Fix: P31.F1.

acceptance.walkthrough: (1) push + deploy so POST /api/documents/check exists on knowledge.hi2vi.com (OQ1); (2) reinstall the CLI from cli/ (uv tool install --reinstall .), knowledge --version = 0.2.0; (3) knowledge check --format native --title ... --tag ... --tag ... --project -> exit 0, OK would publish, nothing new in the reader; (4) add x to a line -> exit 1 with line N: [raw-html]; (5) read works/phases/active/P31/package/README.md then handoff-explain.md, relay the handoff to the bootstrap agent. Decisions: OQ1 deploy; OQ10 sign Aside profile u1 into the reader as an org member before the first explain review; OQ15 the corrected privacy proof. Decided as drawn: OQ2-OQ9, OQ11-OQ14.
